Row.Text: Herding cats. Farming rain. Teaching a goat to play the trombone. Organizing pirates. All of these are difficult. The vagabonds that attach themselves to the black flag come as they are: tattered, worn, broken…but with a drive for plunder.
Take all comers and make them know the Code – it is their greed, not their equipment, that the pirates need.
Turn the worst-off away. The Republic must have standards.

Of all the pirate corporations in the Republic, Bloody Cutlasses Incorporated (BCI) is the most ruthless. But the recent installation of a walking plank off of the 32nd floor of their corporate headquarters is the most egregious - labor rights activists claim that a recent defenestrated whistleblower was unfairly targeted; BCI’s CEO countered that the worker “were a scurvy dog” and could “blow the devil’s whistle”.
Corporations are ruled by their captains just as pirate ships are.
Pirate justice works only on military pirate ships.
